decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans nos APSP/04BULAVE/0211/JS/SCH1, AM/ELEV/04BULAVE/0211/JS/SCH1 (Amended) and SLP/04BULAVE/3011/JS/SH1received 10th February 2011 submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western flank walls  of the detached outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The approved  detached single storey outbuilding must only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as number No. 4A and 4B Bulstrode Avenue and for no other purpose.  A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover normal residential uses, such as separate self-contained accommodation nor the use of an outbuilding for primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen
description: Erection of proposed outbuilding in the rear garden
